name: Dagger specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully

name: Dagger specialization (Expert)
description: Unlocks dual-wielding for this weapon

name: Dagger specialization (Master)
description: All daggers inflict bleed. Daggers that already did cause double the damage

name: One-handed swords specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully

name: One-handed swords specialization (Expert)
description: Unlocks dual-wielding for this weapon

name: One-handed swords specialization (Master)
description: Critical hit on a 9+

name: One-handed blunt specialization
description: Wield maces & clubs skillfully

name: One-handed blunt specialization (Expert)
description: Unlocks dual-wielding for this weapon

name: One-handed blunt specialization (Master)
description: Critical hit on a 9+

name: One-handed axe specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully

name: One-handed axe specialization (Expert)
description: Unlocks dual-wielding for this weapon

name: One-handed axe specialization (Master)
description: Armor reduction value is doubled

name: Two-handed swords specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully

name: Two-handed swords specialization (Expert)
description: Gain an extra attack with this weapon type

name: Two-handed swords specialization (Master)
description: Armor reduction is doubled

name: Two-handed Axe specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully.

name: Two-handed Axe specialization (Expert)
description: Gain an extra attack with this weapon type

name: Two-handed Axe specialization (Master)
description: Critical hit on a 9+

name: Two-handed blunt specialization
description: Wield greatclubs and warmaces skillfully

name: Two-handed blunt specialization (Expert)
description: Gain an extra attack with this weapon type.

name: Two-handed blunt specialization (Master)
description: Add an armor reduction equal to the user’s strength

name: Polearm specialization
description: Wield spears, halberds, and bardiches skillfully

name: Polearm specialization (Expert)
description: Charging with this weapon type applies double the damage

name: Polearm specialization (Master)
description: Polearm may be used to vault up to 5 tiles, passing obstacles without AoO

name: Bow specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully

name: Bow specialization (Expert)
description: Fire in melee range without penalty

name: Bow specialization (Master)
description: Arrows ignore shields and helmets

name: Crossbow specialization
description: Wield this type of weapon skillfully

name: Crossbow specialization (Expert)
description: Fire in melee range without penalty

name: Crossbow specialization (Master)
description: Darts ignore shields and helmets

name: Exotic specialization
description: Wield unique weapons skillfully

name: Exotic specialization (Expert)
description: Depends on weapon

name: Exotic specialization (Master)
description: Depends on the weapon

name: Light armor specialization
description: Wear light armor with 0 movement penalties

name: Medium armor specialization
description: Wear medium armor with half penalties.

name: Heavy armor specialization
description: Wear heavy armor with half penalties.

name: Superheavy armor
description: Wear superheavy armor at all.

name: Shield specialization
description: Gain full damage mitigation from shields instead of half.

name: Buckler specialization
description: Roll a D10 for any to hit roll missed by an enemy. On a 10, receive a counter-attack.

name: Tower shield specialization
description: Gain access to superheavy shields

name: Pistol specialization
description: Learn to use pistols.

name: Pistol specialization (Expert)
description: Enables dual-wield for this weapon type.

name: Pistol specialization (Master)
description: Once per event, perform a quick reload allowing for a second attack cycle.

name: Rifle specialization
description: Learn to use rifles

name: Rifle specialization (Expert)
description: Eliminates the chance of triggering the misfire table.

name: Rifle specialization (Master)
description: Ignore an amount of armor equal to double the rifleman’s finesse.

name: Great weapon specialization
description: Able to wield enormous weapons, not realistically made for human use.

name: Mounted combat
description: Fight effectively from horseback, adding speed value of your mount to total damage.

name: Lancer
description: Any attack made with a polearm whilst mounted crits on a 7

name: Item specialization
description: Use an additional item per turn.

name: Item specialization (Master)
description: +1 extra item uses per turn.

name: Item specialization (Expert)
description: Items scale with relevant stats.

name: Charge
description: Roll a D6 and add that number to your usual move distance. If this allows you to reach an enemy, attack them with +2 to your strength.

name: Jumping strike
description: Leap up to 3 extra tiles to strike an enemy for 2d6+strength+weapon damage.

name: Dynamic landing
description: Add an additional 2d4 aoe damage to your jumps.

name: Sweep
description: Hit all enemies in a 180° angle for weapon damage+strength+1d8

name: Full spin
description: Hit everything around you for damage+strength+1d6

name: Thrown weapon
description: Hurl your weapon at a distant enemy for guaranteed crit damage+strength+finesse. Hits on a finesse roll.

name: Throwing lunatic
description: You can perform a free throwing action with anything in your reach, assuming you can lift it with your strength.

name: Power strike
description: You perform a powerful, crushing blow that negates half the enemy’s armor and does critical weapon damage+1d10+STR. Every foe in range gets an attack of opportunity before it lands.

name: Disarming strike/Shot
description: Roll against finesse. If you win, the enemy is forced to surrender an attack and their item opportunity to pick up their weapon before attacking. Also inflicts strength+weapon damage.

name: Taunt
description: Force an enemy to attack you. Does not work if enemy is already compelled to attack a different target.

name: Guardian
description: Force all enemies in 1d6 range to attack you, unless otherwise compelled.

name: Bash
description: Strength check against an enemy. If you win, they are stunned for 1 turn and receive 2d4+strength damage. If you lose, they take the damage but get a free attack.

name: Shield bash
description: Add shield’s damage resistance to your strength check result.

name: Backstabber
description: 8 and 9 on a to hit roll count as critical hits, so long as you attack from behind and those rolls would’ve hit anyway. (i.e. with 1 finesse, only a 9 or 10 would count).

name: Encouraging shout
description: All allies gain +1 to a stat of your choosing this turn. Does not stack!

name: Intimidating shout
description: Charisma check. If you win, reduce all enemy stats by one.

name: Rallying cry
description: Every ally is healed for 2d10, knocked out allies recover. Only works once per day.

name: Dodge
description: While wearing light armor, roll a D10 against any successful melee hit. On a 9 or 10, the hit doesn’t count. Roll separately against criticals. If you dodge, it only counts as a normal hit.

name: Uncanny dodge
description: Dodge on a 8. Can also be used against non-AoE ranged and magic.

name: Savior
description: Once per battle, jump in front of an ally within movement distance to save them from an attack. If you have charge, you can roll to add the charge distance to Savior’s reach.

name: Armored struggle
description: Roll to hold a person and force them to the ground, inflicting an amount of damage equal to your armor value and reducing their finesse by 3.

name: Deadly Reach
description: Passively doubles the reach at which you can make attacks of opportunities. I.e. anyone passing within 2 blocks from you is targetable or 4 blocks with a long weapon.

name: Rapid Thrust
description: Roll 1d6 dices and add 3. You get to make that amount of additional attacks with a one-handed melee weapon of choice, but with -2 Finesse and no strength bonus.

name: Final Strike/Execution
description: Execute a knocked down opponent with a melee strikes or ranged weapon. Must be adjacent and not have used any of your other abilities yet that turn. Inflicts 3d8+critical weapon damage. If this kills the enemy, regain 2d10 HP as a surge of confidence.

name: Reclaimed opportunity
description: Passive buff. While moving your character, gain a free attack on any enemy you pass. Treating your own movement as if THEY triggered an attack of opportunity. Enemies do still also get attacks of opportunity on you.

name: Dead eye
description: Elect a target that receives -2 finesse against ranged damage and loses all special defenses.

name: Triple-shot
description: Fire at 3 targets at once with -2 finesse on top of your regular shots.

name: Kneecapper
description: Fire a shot out of your turn trip up an enemy, inflicting 2d3 damage+weapon.

name: Ballbuster
description: Leave cover, lose your bloodline. Interrupt a male enemy’s movement for a targeted shot inflicting 2d6+critical weapon damage.

name: Piercing shot
description: Ranged shot that pierces in a straight line, ignoring all armor. Inflicting 2d6+weapon damage to all targets hit.

name: Impact shot
description: Upgrades piercing shot with critical damage. On top of an additional 3d6 damage for enemies within 1 square, 2d6 for 2-5 squares away, or 1d6 for distant targets. Also adds to the bleed counter.

name: Exploding shot
description: Roll for finesse to fire at any target, doing weapon damage. Your projectile then explodes for aoe damage in a 2+d4 radius. Inflicting 10+1d6 damage.

name: Ranger marks
description: Gain access to the marks system.

name: First aid
description: Mend minor wounds on a successful finesse roll

name: Doctoring
description: A sequence of difficult finesse rolls to perform riskier operations.

name: Repair
description: restoring slightly-damaged items, armor, and clothes on a successful roll. Governing skill finesse for cloth/leather, but strength for armors.

name: Crafting
description: Roll finesse to create items from basic resources or restore badly-damaged equipment.

name: Potion Making
description: Ability to forage local plants to create basic potions.

name: Woodcutting
description: Roll to fell trees and receive lumber.

name: Tracking
description: Roll for spirit to gain a sense of where an animal or target has gone.

name: Fishing
description: Self-evident *Those with fishing skill catch 1d5+2 fish. Without, you only catch 1d3.

name: Cooking
description: Yum *Rolls of 1 are a fail, 2-8 give a good meal, 9-10 a great meal. Without skill 1-5 is a fail, 6-10 a good meal.

name: Skinning
description: Roll for finesse to gain animal pelts.

name: Thieving
description: Roll for finesse to pickpocket or take items without being noticed.

name: Smithing
description: Creating basic armors from raw materials.

name: Clothesmaking
description: Creating clothes from cloth, leather, and other light materials.

name: Musician
description: Use charisma to inspire or otherwise influence your allies with music.

name: Artistry
description: Roll for charisma to create artistic objects, like paintings or sculptures.

name: Alcoholic
description: You gain finesse from drinking alcohol instead of losing it. However, you still lose intelligence from drinking.

name: Swimming
description: Roll for strength to not drown. Armor value is deducted from your roll.

name: Riding
description: To be able to ride horses. Or, you know, whatever else you can convince to be a mount.

name: Identification
description: Roll for spirit to discover the properties of magical items.

name: Blend
description: Use charisma to hide in plain sight, acting as if you belong. Context influences effectiveness, you can’t just blend your way past the king straight into his wife’s bedchambers.

name: Sneak
description: When wearing light armor, move silently so as not to alert.

name: Taming
description: Convincing animals to stay by your side and do your bidding.

name: Trap-finding
description: Have a chance of innately sensing traps. Without trap-finding, players have to guess when to search for traps and make an intelligence roll to pass it.

name: Lockpicking
description: Opening locks to which you have lost the key. Finesse roll.

name: Stealth
description: Merge into the world of shadows for complete invisibility. Every turn spent in stealth, you need to roll 2+ on a d10 to see if you can remain stealthed. With the required roll going up by 1 each turn.

name: Magic: Fire
description: High damage, burning

name: Magic: Water
description: Utility, moderate damage

name: Magic: Ice
description: Utility, piercing damage

name: Magic: Blood
description: High, debilitating damage.

name: Magic: Thunder
description: Area-of-effect damage

name: Magic: Earthen
description: Moderate, physical damage

name: Magic: Wind
description: Variety of direct and large area-of-effect spells

name: Magic: Force
description: Magic that directly influences physics

name: Magic: Illusion
description: Manipulation and trickery

name: Magic: Enhancement
description: Magic that specializes in temporary buffs

name: Magic: Nature
description: Manipulate plants and restore life.

name: Magic: Necromancy
description: Resurrecting and communicating with the dead.

name: Magic: Darkness
description: Extremely powerful magic which drains your lifeforce in return.

name: Magic: Nightmare
description: Psychologically damaging magic

name: Magic: Shapeshifting
description: Change your physical form or that of others.

name: Magic: Corruption
description: Poison, acid, and rot.

name: Reaction spells
description: Unlock the ability to cast a limited selection of spells outside of your actual turn.

name: Reaction Spell: Magic sensing (1MP)
description: Detect and trace sources of magic.

name: Reaction Spell: Dispel (1MP)
description: Cancel a magical effect (burning, curse, slow, petrification) on a person. Or use 2MP to cast it as an area-of-effect.

name: Reaction Spell: Diffuse (xMP)
description: A last-ditch defense spell that can be cast as a reaction. Reduce the damage of an incoming hit by 5+xd6. Where x is the amount of mana input.

name: Reaction Spell: Magical device (1MP)
description: Channel magic to use magical machinery.

name: Stealth (Shadow Realm)
description: Fade into a world of shadows. Can only be maintained for an amount of turns equal to half-spirit before it becomes harmful to the user.

name: Bible of Illumus
description: Prayers meant to oppose evil and call upon divine aid

name: Bible of Felis
description: Powerful healing magic

name: Bible of Gulf
description: Prayers to enhance physical power

name: Bible of Serena
description: Cleansing and magical damage

name: Bible of Koth
description: Anti-undead prayers

name: Bible of Gorün
description: Quiet prayers to aid in work and crafting

name: Bible of Merena
description: Prayers to call forth destruction and chaos

name: Bible of Zuul
description: Beg Zuul to better your odds or reshape reality to your advantage

name: Bible of Nesfeth
description: Quiet curses to unleash upon your enemies

name: Desperate prayer
description: Throw out an aimless prayer and roll for spirit. Who knows who or what might answer.

name: Devotion
description: Gain a permanent, God-specific buff. (requires maxed out bible)

name: Divine rivalry
description: Once per day, muster your piety to do double damage for a turn against a follower of a rival God (requires min 3 tiers in a bible)

name: Unity
description: Roll for spirit to sense other followers of your faith nearby.

name: Fallen follower
description: Become an enemy of your faith. Your progress in a bible is converted into stat points and you gain a permanent damage bonus against your former comrades.

name: Suppressing fire
description: Gain a free ranged attack shot at any enemy moving within your line-of-sight.

name: Snipe
description: Sacrifice 2 of your shots for that turn for a guaranteed hit that crits on a 6+. If your shot would have crit anyway, damage is quadrupled.

name: Volley
description: Release a flurry of arrow fire on a designated area, damaging anything within for 3d3+ weapon damage.

name: Bullet Time
description: When targeted by projectiles, gain +7 dodge and move into cover outside your turn.

name: Kneebreaker
description: A targeted attack at an enemy’s legs. Roll a 1d3. 1: fail, 2: half movement, 3: unable to move. Effect lasts 3 turns and can’t be stacked, but can be cured.

name: Earthshaker
description: A forceful blow to the earth. Enemies within 2 tiles range receive 2d6 damage and are blown 1d3 tiles away.

name: Blade twist
description: Use after landing a hit to twist your melee weapon, inflicting bleed on your enemy +1d6 damage.

name: Assassinate
description: Strike a target out of stealth or hiding for quadruple your weapon damage.

name: Silent killer
description: Perform assassinate with a guarantee that nobody hears a thing, unless your victim survives. CAN NOT BE USED WITH GUNS OR GREAT WEAPONS.

name: Rage
description: You succumb to anger, halving your finesse and foregoing the benefits of a shield, but doubling your attack for this turn.

name: Natural armor
description: Your muscles are your shield! Gain an armor value equal to your endurance so long as no other armor is worn (helms do not count).

name: Professional nudist
description: The effect of natural armor is doubled.

name: High on violence
description: Upon defeating a worthy enemy, immediately regain your movement and 1 attack.

name: Dismembering strike
description: A precise strike causing 2d8+weapon damage. Roll a strength check after and select a limb to cut off, inflicting an additional double-crit weapon damage + 2d4 bleed.

name: Engineering
description: Ability to maintain and repair mechanical constructions on a successful intelligence roll.

name: Driving
description: Ability to ride and control mechanical vehicles

name: Social grace
description: Quick wits and charm allow you to reroll a failed charisma check. You’re allowed to change the type of roll as well, i.e. failing an intimidation attempt, passing it off as a joke, and persuading the target instead.

name: Borrowed strength
description: Add the value of a companion’s strength to your own when rolling for intimidation.

name: Gunslinging
description: Utilize different types of ammo for different effects. Ammo types must first be bought or crafted with tinkering.

name: Gunslinging: Incendiary rounds
description: Add +1 fire damage to each bullet and leave targets burning.

name: Gunslinging: AP rounds
description: Ignore half the enemy’s armor value.

name: Gunslinging: Fullmetal Jacket
description: Misfire chance is eliminated.

name: Gunslinging: Arcane rounds
description: Add +2 magic damage to bullets.

name: Gunslinging: Tracer rounds
description: Add +2 finesse for the purpose of ranged attacks for all allies.

name: Gunslinging: Explosive rounds
description: Add +3 damage to all shots, but misfires on a 3 or lower.

name: Gunslinging: Holy rounds
description: +2 damage per shot against opposite faith.

name: Gunslinging: Paint rounds
description: No damage, but fun colors.

name: Gunslinging: Penetrator rounds
description: Ignore cover and can fire through walls.

name: Self-help
description: For every turn downed, roll a 3+ on a 1d6 to see if you can recover by yourself while combat is ongoing. Healing yourself for 10+1d10 in the process. Roll required goes up by 1 after each down.
